## Setup

Read the textbook chapter - [Time to event models](https://websites.umich.edu/~thofer/teach/hhcr-book/time_to_event.html)

The data for the lab can be loaded by running the following commands:

Right heart catheterization data (SUPPORT study)

```stata
use https://tphofer.github.io/ncsp-hhcr/data/rhc_class_tph.dta, clear
```

Lung cancer data (NCCTG)

```stata
use https://tphofer.github.io/ncsp-hhcr/data/lung.dta, clear
```

The datasets are described on the [Datafiles](data.qmd) page.
